title: Fix Service/Product category dropdown overlap and add bilingual §13b reverse-charge note

requirements.text: Fix the “Service/Product Category” dropdown UI so the selected value is always clearly readable and never overlaps with other text in the control (including in narrow/mobile layouts).

quotes: amend the APP, show the Service/ Product category clearly in the dropdown without overlapping over other text.

acceptanceCriteria: On the Transaction Details step, the “Service/Product Category” select shows the current selection without text overlapping the dropdown chevron, label, or adjacent UI.
Long option labels (e.g., “Consulting / freelance”) remain readable via truncation/wrapping rules without causing overlap or layout breakage.
Verified on both desktop and mobile viewport widths.

requirements.text: When the VAT result is reverse-charge with 0% VAT, display a two-line comment directly under the reverse-charge output: line 1 (German) must be exactly “Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers (§13b UStG)”; line 2 (English) must be exactly “Tax liability of the recipient of services (§13b UStG)”.

quotes: For reverse charge of 0%, show the comments "Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers (§13b UStG)” in German language and English translation of "Tax liability of the recipient of services (§13b UStG)”  under.

acceptanceCriteria: If the calculation scenario is reverse-charge (VAT 0%), the UI shows the German line followed immediately by the English line underneath.
If the scenario is not reverse-charge, this bilingual §13b comment is not shown.
The text matches exactly (including punctuation, capitalization, and the § symbol).

requirements.text: When generating the invoice preview for a reverse-charge (0%) result, include the same bilingual §13b comment as the legal VAT note in the invoice content: first the German line “Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers (§13b UStG)”, then a new line with the English line “Tax liability of the recipient of services (§13b UStG)”.

quotes: For reverse charge of 0%, show the comments "Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers (§13b UStG)” in German language and English translation of "Tax liability of the recipient of services (§13b UStG)”  under.

acceptanceCriteria: For reverse-charge invoices, the Legal Note section in the invoice preview contains both lines in the specified order, separated by a visible line break.
For non-reverse-charge invoices, the invoice legal note behavior remains unchanged.
The text matches exactly (including punctuation, capitalization, and the § symbol).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (these are read-only vendor components).
Keep all backend logic in the existing single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); no new backend services.
nonGoals: Changing VAT calculation rules or eligibility logic for reverse charge; only adjust displayed wording/presentation.
Adding new authentication providers or external integrations.
